name: Hand-Drawn Map
description: A map drawn by hand, pinned beside the community radio studio console. Used as part of the station's operational setup during the post-storm recovery period.
narrative_significance: The hand-drawn map serves as a functional tool for the community radio station's emergency broadcast operations, pinned by Aria as part of establishing OPEN FREQUENCY. It represents the station's role in coordinating post-disaster information and recovery efforts for Red Creek.
